description: This file defines a custom exception class 'CSVUploadFailedException' within the OrangeHRM system. The exception is used to indicate failures during CSV upload validation.

classes.name: CSVUploadFailedException
classes.description: A custom exception class that signals CSV upload validation failure, extending the base PHP Exception class.

methods.name: validationFailed
methods.description: Static method that creates and returns an instance of CSVUploadFailedException with a predefined message indicating validation failure.

calls: new self("The CSV File Is Not Valid")
